An https image URL is extracted into metadata.images when extract_metadata is true

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var optionsJson = "{\"extract_metadata\":true}";
        var options = JsonUtil.fromJson(optionsJson, ConversionOptions.class);
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<p><img src=\"https://example.com/photo.jpg\" alt=\"A photo\"></p>", options);
        System.out.println(result.content());
        System.out.println(result.metadata().images());
    }
}
```
